name: Fieldset
summary: Use a fieldset and legend to group related form controls under one question or shared label.
whenToUse: Use to group related controls such as a radio group, checkbox group, date input or multi-part address.
Use a legend as the page heading when the group is the page's main question.
whenNotToUse: Do not use a fieldset around a single, independently labelled text input.
Do not use visual spacing alone to imply that controls belong to one question.

anatomy.name: Fieldset
anatomy.description: The native fieldset contains every control belonging to the group.

anatomy.name: Legend
anatomy.description: The first child is a clear govuk-fieldset__legend that labels the entire group.

anatomy.name: Grouped controls
anatomy.description: Each child control still has its own label where required.

variants.name: Default legend
variants.use: A related group within a larger page.

variants.name: Legend as page heading
variants.use: The fieldset question is the page's primary heading and contains an h1 with govuk-fieldset__heading.

behaviour: No GOV.UK JavaScript module is required for the fieldset itself.
Keep the legend as the first meaningful child so browsers announce it with each grouped control.
Place group hint and error content in the related form group and link it using the component's documented IDs.
accessibility: Use native fieldset and legend rather than role=group when native grouping is available.
Do not leave the legend empty or hide it when users need the group question.
Avoid nested fieldsets unless the question hierarchy remains clear in tested assistive technologies.
content: Write the legend as a direct question or concise group label.
Do not repeat the same wording in a separate heading and legend when the legend can be the heading.

htmlExamples.name: Address group
htmlExamples.html:
<fieldset class="govuk-fieldset">
  <legend class="govuk-fieldset__legend">What is your address?</legend>
  <label class="govuk-label" for="address-line-1">Address line 1</label>
  <input class="govuk-input" id="address-line-1" name="addressLine1" type="text">
</fieldset>
